display.purpose: Section and hero headlines only (Cormorant Garamond).

label.purpose: Eyebrows, nav links, small UI labels (Work Sans).

shadows.name: button-hover
shadows.purpose: The only shadow in the system — appears solely on primary-button hover, never at rest.

motion.name: ease-standard
motion.purpose: Default easing for Framer Motion fade+rise entrances (FadeIn component).

motion.name: duration-hover
motion.purpose: Standard color/background transition duration on hover-affected CSS classes (.nav-link, .footer-link, etc.).

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: Fully rounded pill button, Ink Brown fill, used for the main CTA on any surface.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { background: oklch(0.28 0.02 60); color: oklch(0.975 0.012 85); border: none; border-radius: 9999px; padding: 14px 30px; font-family: 'Work Sans', ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 14px; font-weight: 500; transition: background-color 0.2s, box-shadow 0.2s, transform 0.2s; cursor: pointer; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background: oklch(0.34 0.03 60); box-shadow: 0 6px 16px -8px oklch(0.28 0.02 60 / 0.4); transform: translateY(-1px); } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid oklch(0.7 0.06 20); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Outline Button
components.description: Transparent pill button with an Ink Brown border, used for secondary actions.
components.css: .ds-btn-outline { background: transparent; color: oklch(0.28 0.02 60); border: 1.5px solid oklch(0.28 0.02 60); border-radius: 9999px; padding: 14px 30px; font-family: 'Work Sans', ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 14px; font-weight: 500; transition: background-color 0.2s, border-color 0.2s, transform 0.2s; cursor: pointer; } .ds-btn-outline:hover { background: oklch(0.28 0.02 60 / 0.06); border-color: oklch(0.2 0.02 60); transform: translateY(-1px); } .ds-btn-outline:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid oklch(0.7 0.06 20); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Nav Link
components.description: Signature component — uses a conditional inline color override for the active-route state layered on top of a CSS class that owns default/hover color. See DESIGN.md Components > Navigation for why this exact shape must be preserved.
components.css: .ds-nav-link { color: oklch(0.28 0.02 60); font-family: 'Work Sans', ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 13px; font-weight: 500; text-decoration: none; transition: color 0.2s ease; } .ds-nav-link:hover, .ds-nav-link:focus-visible { color: oklch(0.55 0.09 20); }

components.name: Card
components.description: Flat card surface, no resting shadow, distinguished from the page only by a slightly lighter/warmer background.
components.css: .ds-card { background: oklch(0.98 0.01 85); border: 1px solid oklch(0.85 0.02 60); border-radius: 0.75rem; padding: 24px; }

components.name: Text Input
components.description: Standard form field — thin clay border, warm terracotta-family focus ring instead of a generic blue.
components.css: .ds-input { background: oklch(0.98 0.01 85); border: 1px solid oklch(0.85 0.02 60); border-radius: 0.6rem; padding: 10px 14px; font-family: 'Work Sans', ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 14px; color: oklch(0.28 0.02 60); } .ds-input:focus { outline: 2px solid oklch(0.7 0.06 20); outline-offset: 1px; }

narrative.overview: Crochette reads like a small studio's own table, not a marketplace template: warm cream paper, soft dusty-rose and terracotta accents, and generous editorial serif headlines that feel handwritten-adjacent rather than corporate. Density is low and unhurried — pages breathe, imagery leads, and the terracotta accent is used sparingly enough that it still reads as a signature rather than a system color. The system runs on two deliberately different implementation modes for two deliberately different jobs: storefront/marketing chrome is hand-authored with inline styles plus dedicated hover CSS classes, while admin CRUD surfaces are pure Tailwind/shadcn.
keyCharacteristics: Warm cream background, near-black-brown ink text (never pure black)
Cormorant Garamond serif display type paired with Work Sans body type
Terracotta as a rare, signature accent — not a workhorse UI color
Flat by default; no drop shadows as a resting state
Framer Motion used only for transform/opacity, always prefers-reduced-motion-aware

rules.name: The Rare Accent Rule
rules.body: Terracotta is reserved for links, the active nav-link indicator, and small signature moments — never a background or button-fill color, never more than one or two elements per viewport.

rules.name: The Warm-Neutral-Only Rule
rules.body: Every neutral in this system carries the same warm brown/cream hue family. Do not introduce a cool gray — that is shadcn's default, which this project explicitly overrides.

rules.name: The Serif-For-Headlines-Only Rule
rules.body: Cormorant Garamond never appears in body copy, buttons, or form inputs — reserved for headline-weight moments only.

rules.name: The Flat-By-Default Rule
rules.body: Surfaces are flat at rest. A shadow may appear only as a direct response to interaction state (button hover), never as a static floating-card effect.

dos: Do treat the inline-style-vs-CSS-specificity rule in app/globals.css as load-bearing.
Do keep storefront chrome in its inline-style-plus-hover-classes mode and admin CRUD forms in their pure-Tailwind mode — two intentional systems, not drift.
Do treat the oklch tokens in :root as the single source of truth for color.
Do keep Framer Motion animations transform/opacity-only, prefers-reduced-motion-aware, and running once.
donts: Don't migrate inline-styled storefront pages to Tailwind/shadcn as a side effect of a general polish/audit pass — that migration was already proposed and rejected.
Don't simplify the nav-link conditional-inline-override idiom — it previously caused a real regression when simplified.
Don't restructure GalleryTile.tsx, PillGroup.tsx, or ProductCard.tsx to match shadcn conventions.
Don't apply brand-priority visual polish to /admin — it's intentionally plainer and functional-priority.
Don't introduce a cool-gray neutral anywhere.
